discovery_question: Which first-session change would get more new trials to a first project within 7 days?
decision_informed: Which onboarding idea earns a lean PRD and which ideas are dropped before any build.

statements.text: 248 of 800 September 2026 trials activated within 7 days, 31 percent.
Trials created without sample data activated at 23 percent.
14 of 40 reviewed trial support chats asked how to start a first project, 35 percent.
9 of 40 reviewed trial support chats asked where the welcome guide was.
Trial users who start from a template create a first project sooner than users who start empty.
A guide shown at first login does the job the delayed welcome email no longer does.
Existing sample-data fixtures can seed three starter templates.
The separate effect of any onboarding change is unknown.
statements.resolution: Random assignment in the guide A/B test below.

statements.text: How many trial users would choose a template is unknown: no template feature or usage event exists.
statements.resolution: Log clicks on a fake-door template button before building anything.

opportunities.framing: I open an empty workspace and do not know what to build first.
I cannot find the getting-started help when I first log in.

ideas.title: Starter template picker
ideas.summary: Offer three ready-made projects on the empty workspace.

ideas.title: In-app first-step guide
ideas.summary: A short guide panel opens at first login and walks through a first project.

ideas.title: Activation leaderboard
ideas.summary: Show trial teams how they rank against other new teams.
ideas.reason: Requester declined it: it ranks trial users publicly (E3).

ideas.title: Spreadsheet import
ideas.summary: Create a first project from an uploaded spreadsheet.

ideas.title: Event-triggered welcome email
ideas.summary: Send the welcome email from the sign-up event instead of the nightly batch.

checkpoints.question: Which of these five ideas should be stress-tested?
Which risky assumptions should be tested first?

assumptions.text: New trial users will pick a template rather than start empty.
Three templates can be seeded from existing sample-data fixtures.
Users who see the guide at first login reach a first project within 7 days more often.
Experienced users can dismiss the guide without friction.

experiments.setup: Show a 'Start from a template' button on the empty workspace to half of new trials; a click explains templates are coming and is logged.

hypothesis.population: New trial accounts that land on an empty workspace
hypothesis.behavior_or_outcome: Click 'Start from a template' in their first session
hypothesis.rationale: 35 percent of reviewed chats asked how to start a first project.
hypothesis.measurement: Template-button click events divided by exposed trials
hypothesis.counter_metric: First-project creation rate among exposed trials
hypothesis.failure_rule: Drop the template idea if fewer than 10 percent click within 14 days.

experiments.risk_mitigation: The button says the feature is not built yet; exposure is half of new trials behind a flag that can be switched off.
experiments.if_pass: Write a lean PRD for the template picker.
experiments.if_fail: Drop the template idea and keep the guide branch.

experiments.setup: Show the guide at first login to a random half of new trials; the welcome email stays unchanged in both arms.

hypothesis.behavior_or_outcome: Create a first project within 7 days
hypothesis.intervention: In-app first-step guide at first login
hypothesis.rationale: Guide questions appear in support chats and delayed-email trials activated less.
hypothesis.failure_rule: Stop if the guide arm is not at least 3 points above control after 28 days.

experiments.risk_mitigation: Control keeps today's experience; the guide can be dismissed and the flag rolled back.
experiments.if_pass: Keep the guide for all new trials.
experiments.if_fail: Remove the guide and revisit the event-triggered email idea.

next_action.action: Add the template-button click event, then start the fake-door test on half of new trials.
